outputs.discrepancies: The caption for panel G only describes immunoblotting/zymography comparing normal mucosa (N) and polyps (P) between ApcMin/+ and Asef-/-ApcMin/+ mice using similarly sized polyps. However, the panel image also includes an additional blot (right side) showing Asef, pJNK1, JNK1, MMP9 (zymo) and Actin levels across polyps of increasing diameter (2, 3, 4, 5 mm) plus normal tissue (N). This additional size-series blot is not mentioned or explained anywhere in the caption text.
